description: Search the Security Startups directory of young security companies. Filters combine with AND. Returns public fields and each company's page URL, alphabetical by name (not a ranking).

category.description: Category slug or name, e.g. application-security. See list_categories.

funding_stage.description: Funding stage, e.g. Seed, Series A, Series C.

limit.description: Results to return, 1 to 50; larger values are capped at 50.

query.description: Free text matched against name, summary, description, category, tags, HQ and investors.

name: search_startups
title: Search security startups
